objective: test whether remaining-workflow structure changes a legal native preparation decision without claiming an algorithm advantage

candidate_actions.1: predictive_next_rsu_prefetch for the current node adapter
candidate_actions.4: handoff_migration_prepare for the current node adapter/state abstraction

paired_instances.long: current node followed by two nodes that reuse b0.a0
current node followed by b0.a0 then b1.a0
paired_instances.changed_information: whether current adapter is reused before the later base switch

rules.information: current node and current RSU only; the same reuse test receives no remaining-tail sequence
rules.decision: action 0 because no tail reuse is observable

rules.information: current plus next node adapter and native mobility prediction
rules.decision: action 1 only when next node reuses current adapter at predicted RSU, else action 0

rules.information: remaining adapter sequence but no future stochastic outcomes
rules.decision: action 1 when the current adapter is reused after the predicted handoff, else action 0

rules.information: the same remaining adapter sequence and native mobility prediction as remaining_workflow_reuse
rules.decision: action 4 when the current adapter is reused after the predicted handoff, else action 0

metrics: step completion time proxy only as native step count
workflow-state transfer bytes when natively emitted

cost_sources.simulation: native CacheEvent and transaction ledger only
cost_sources.network_time: not measured; no latency conversion will be claimed
cost_sources.sensitivity: algebraic break-even thresholds with assumptions shown explicitly

failure_policy: if a rule cannot be expressed by a normal ActionAdapter output accepted by the environment, record unreachable and stop that witness; do not strengthen it into an oracle
